aiResearchSummary.text: Liyfe is engaged in research and development of a digital nurse for symptom and risk assessment, as described in the title and abstract of a system and method for intelligent symptom assessment through a machine learning-driven digital assistance platform. This technology processes user input via a chatbot environment to automate symptom assessment and risk prediction, aligning with the company’s focus on oncology and NASH. Liyfe’s R&D centers on digital health solutions for automated clinical evaluation.
